### Nordson Corporation Announces Earnings Release and Webcast for Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026


November 6, 2026


WESTLAKE, Ohio--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Nordson Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nordson.com%2F&esheet=54636878&newsitemid=20261106232666&lan=en-US&anchor=Nordson+Corporation&index=1&md5=fb62f19eb8b4d499185d569a873d67b8) **** (Nasdaq: NDSN) today announced it will release fourth quarter and fiscal year 2026 earnings on December 15, 2026, after the close of the market. Nordson will host its quarterly webcast on:


Date:


Wednesday, December 16, 2026


Time:


8:30 AM ET


Link to listen:


[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/811712771](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Furl.us.m.mimecastprotect.com%2Fs%2F5JZCCv2wDyfWLK9w4SyClOtQrTR7%3Fdomain%3Devents.q4inc.com&esheet=54636878&newsitemid=20261106232666&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F811712771&index=2&md5=4dafca3f2a204924311411012c7cfc30)


Investors who are interested in listening to the webcast but are unable to participate during the scheduled time can access the replay by visiting[Nordson's investor website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.nordson.com%2Fhome%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54636878&newsitemid=20261106232666&lan=en-US&anchor=Nordson%27s+investor+website&index=3&md5=4a8694431bfce5540d4f87a13e17a8dd) .


Nordson Corporation is an innovative precision technology company that leverages a scalable growth framework through an entrepreneurial, division-led organization to deliver top tier growth with leading margins and returns. The Company’s direct sales model and applications expertise serves global customers through a wide variety of critical applications. Its diverse end market exposure includes consumer non-durable, medical, electronics and industrial end markets. Founded in 1954 and headquartered in Westlake, Ohio, the Company has operations and support offices in over 35 countries. Visit Nordson on the web at[www.nordson.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nordson.com%2F&esheet=54636878&newsitemid=20261106232666&lan=en-US&anchor=www.nordson.com&index=4&md5=ecc323490ec98b748bf488b36ec4d8d3) or[linkedin/Nordson](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fnordson-corporation%2Fposts%2F&esheet=54636878&newsitemid=20261106232666&lan=en-US&anchor=linkedin%2FNordson&index=5&md5=03562e5fc75919da117415ec089c4470) .
